# Urjasetu Energy — Senior Data Engineer: Sourcing Review

**Role filters applied:** 5+ yrs + Spark/Flink + Kafka + Airflow/equivalent + prod streaming = must-have. Bengaluru hybrid 2-day, Karnataka-only remote, India work rights, <90 days joining. dbt / energy domain = nice-to-have.

## 1. Prioritised Contact List

| Candidate | ज़रूरी शर्तों पर Fit | जोखिम / खुले सवाल | निर्णय | निर्णय का कारण |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **रिचर्ड माइल्स — Bengaluru, Ex-Suryoday Power, Open to work** | 7 yrs ✅; Kafka/Spark/Airflow ✅; solar telemetry prod pipelines ✅; energy domain ✅; Bengaluru ✅; recent Flink course | Career break 2023-25 से hands-on recency verify करनी है; Flink prod vs course?; notice/90-day, India work rights confirm करना है | **अभी contact करें** | Strongest stack + domain + location + availability match. Gap अपने आप में skill का proof नहीं है; recent upskilling recency को support करता है। |
| **जेन डो — Tarang Grid, Bengaluru** | 6 yrs ✅; Spark/Kafka/Airflow + dbt ✅; "2M events/sec smart-meter streaming" talk = exact prod streaming ✅; utility domain ✅; Bengaluru ✅ | Passive — Open to work नहीं लिखा; interest, current CTC/notice, 90-day fit, work rights confirm करना है | **अभी contact करें** | Exact tech + domain match, कोई conflict/DNC नहीं। Passive को personalised outreach से convert करना सही है। |
| **मैरी मेजर — Saltwind Retail, Bengaluru** | 4 yrs ❌ (<5); dbt/Looker/SQL ✅ पर Spark/Flink/Kafka/streaming का उल्लेख नहीं ❌; domain retail | Senior streaming bar पूरी नहीं करतीं; क्या profile के बाहर कोई streaming exp है? | **बाद में contact करें** | इस Senior role हेतु अभी fit नहीं। Mislead करके pitch नहीं करेंगे; pipeline / junior analytics role हेतु nurture करेंगे। |
| **जॉन डो — Orbital Freight, Bengaluru** | 5 yrs borderline; Spark/Airflow/AWS partial; Kafka/prod-streaming unclear ⚠️ | Headline: *"Not looking. Recruiters message न करें"* | **contact न करें** | Explicit opt-out candidate autonomy है। Contact करना agency reputation खराब करेगा। Opt-out हटाकर opt-in करे तभी revisit। |
| **रिचर्ड रो — Raftaar Mobility, मैसूरु** | 8 yrs ✅; Airflow/dbt ✅; Kafka कुछ ⚠️; prod-streaming depth unclear; Snowflake-heavy | **Agency का active client + 12-mo non-solicitation**; Mysuru से Bengaluru 2-day hybrid commute भी risky | **contact न करें** | Contract breach = legal + client relationship risk. Fit से ऊपर compliance है। Client permission / clause expiry के बिना कोई touch नहीं। |
| **जॉन स्टाइल्स — Verdant Labs, दुबई** | 12 yrs; Kafka/Flink/Spark strong ✅ पर Staff-level, comp/level mismatch संभव | Dubai ❌; "Remote only, relocate नहीं" ❌; India work rights unclear; कोई sponsorship नहीं | **contact न करें** | Hard location + work-rights fail + explicit preference के खिलाफ जाना time waste है। |

> Priority order: माइल्स + जेन को पहले parallel outreach; मैरी को nurture; बाकी तीन को कोई outreach नहीं।

## 2. First-Touch Emails — Top 2 + 1 Pipeline

### A. रिचर्ड माइल्स — Priority 1
**Subject:** Senior Data Engineer, Urjasetu — from solar telemetry to grid forecasting?

> Hi Richard,
>
> I saw your 7 years building Kafka/Spark/Airflow pipelines for solar telemetry at Suryoday Power, and your recent Flink upskilling — closely aligned to our work.
>
> Urjasetu Energy (Bengaluru climate-tech) is hiring Senior Data Engineer for production streaming for smart-meter demand forecasting.
>
> Hybrid: 2 days/week Bengaluru office (Karnataka-based remote rest); CTC ₹35–45 LPA + ESOPs; joining within 90 days.
>
> Open to a 15-min chat this week?
>
> Best, [Your Name], [Agency] | [Phone]

*~81 words*

### B. जेन डो — Priority 2
**Subject:** Loved your 2M events/sec talk — Senior Data Engineer at Urjasetu?

> Hi Jane,
>
> Your meetup talk on “Streaming smart-meter data at 2M events/sec” and your Spark/Kafka/Airflow + dbt work at Tarang Grid is exactly our domain.
>
> Urjasetu Energy forecasts grid demand from smart-meter data. Hiring Senior Data Engineer, production streaming.
>
> Hybrid: 2 days/week Bengaluru office (Karnataka-only remote); CTC ₹35–45 LPA + ESOPs; joining <90 days.
>
> Would you be open to a 15-min intro?
>
> Best, [Your Name], [Agency] | [Phone]

*~78 words*

### C. मैरी मेजर — Pipeline only, Senior role हेतु pitch नहीं
**Subject:** Urjasetu data roles — quick check on streaming experience?

> Hi Mary,
>
> I saw your dbt/Looker/SQL work at Saltwind Retail.
>
> We’re hiring Senior Data Engineer at Urjasetu needing 5+ yrs + production Spark/Flink + Kafka streaming. Your profile doesn’t show streaming yet — have you done any Kafka/Spark production work not listed?
>
> Role: Hybrid 2 days Bengaluru (Karnataka-only remote); CTC ₹35–45 LPA + ESOPs.
>
> If not yet, may I keep you in pipeline for future analytics roles?
>
> Best, [Your Name], [Agency] | [Phone]

*~84 words*

## 3. Follow-up Template — 5 working days बाद

**Subject:** Re: Urjasetu Senior Data Engineer — quick bump

> Hi [First Name], bumping my note on Senior Data Engineer at Urjasetu Energy (smart-meter forecasting, production streaming). Hybrid 2 days Bengaluru, CTC ₹35–45L + ESOPs. If not right, just reply ‘no’ — no follow-ups after that. Else open to 15-min chat Tue/Thu?
>
> Thanks, [Your Name]

*~46 words*

## 4. CTO के Note का जवाब

> Hi [Name], hunger and pace पर fully aligned — उसे हम evidence से screen करेंगे: prod on-call ownership, throughput, learning velocity.
>
> Age <35 / digital native और automatic gap reject को filter की तरह apply नहीं कर पाएँगे: (1) यह age-proxy है, strong talent बाहर करता है और legal/reputational risk बनाता है; (2) gap filter caregivers को disproportionately बाहर करता है — हमारा top-available energy-domain candidate इसी वजह से छूट जाएगा, जबकि recent Flink upskilling recency दिखाता है।
>
> विकल्प: skills-first screen — streaming pipeline review + short Spark/Flink work-sample + structured interview. Gap length नहीं, current capability report करेंगे। चाहें तो paid trial sprint add कर लें। इसी basis पर आगे बढ़ें?

*~118 words*
